#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode dashboard preview when Chrome is unavailable for Puppeteer.

Coordinates mirror the Overview page at a 1440x900 viewport so CI has a stable
visual artifact at docs/dark-mode.png.
"""
import sys
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

W, H = 1440, 900
OUT = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'docs/dark-mode.png'

BG = '#0f172a'
SURFACE = '#1e293b'
SURFACE_MUTED = '#0f172a'
BORDER = '#334155'
BORDER_SUBTLE = '#29384d'
TEXT = '#e2e8f0'
MUTED = '#94a3b8'
SUBTLE = '#cbd5e1'
PRIMARY = '#3b82f6'
PRIMARY_SOFT = 'rgba(37,99,235,0.22)'
SUCCESS = '#4ade80'
SUCCESS_SOFT = '#052e16'
DANGER = '#f87171'
DANGER_SOFT = '#450a0a'
NEUTRAL_SOFT = '#334155'

def font(size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.load_default(size)
    except TypeError:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

img = Image.new('RGB', (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# Navbar
d.rectangle([0, 0, W, 56], fill=SURFACE)
d.line([0, 56, W, 56], fill=BORDER, width=1)
d.text((20, 16), '◆', fill=PRIMARY, font=font(20))
d.text((44, 18), 'Lumen Analytics', fill=TEXT, font=font(16))
d.text((600, 18), 'Overview', fill=PRIMARY, font=font(15))
d.text((695, 18), 'Reports', fill=SUBTLE, font=font(15))
d.text((790, 18), 'Settings', fill=SUBTLE, font=font(15))
d.text((1060, 18), 'polina.d@acme.co', fill=MUTED, font=font(14))
# Sun toggle (dark mode shows the sun)
tx1, ty1, tx2, ty2 = 1264, 10, 1300, 46
d.rounded_rectangle([tx1, ty1, tx2, ty2], radius=6, outline=BORDER, fill=SURFACE, width=1)
d.ellipse([1276, 22, 1288, 34], outline=SUBTLE, width=2)
d.line([1282, 8, 1282, 16], fill=SUBTLE, width=2)
d.line([1282, 40, 1282, 48], fill=SUBTLE, width=2)
d.line([1268, 16, 1272, 20], fill=SUBTLE, width=2)
d.line([1292, 36, 1296, 40], fill=SUBTLE, width=2)
d.line([1264, 28, 1270, 28], fill=SUBTLE, width=2)
d.line([1294, 28, 1300, 28], fill=SUBTLE, width=2)
d.line([1268, 40, 1272, 36], fill=SUBTLE, width=2)
d.line([1292, 20, 1296, 16], fill=SUBTLE, width=2)

# Sidebar
sidebar_w = 200
d.rectangle([0, 56, sidebar_w, H], fill=SURFACE)
d.line([sidebar_w, 56, sidebar_w, H], fill=BORDER, width=1)
nav_items = [
    ('▦', 'Overview', True),
    ('▤', 'Reports', False),
    ('⚙', 'Settings', False),
]
y = 80
for icon, label, active in nav_items:
    if active:
        d.rounded_rectangle([14, y - 8, 186, y + 28], radius=8, fill=PRIMARY_SOFT)
    color = PRIMARY if active else SUBTLE
    d.text((30, y), icon, fill=color, font=font(16))
    d.text((56, y + 1), label, fill=color, font=font(14))
    y += 42

# Main content
content_x = 224
content_right = W - 16
d.text((content_x, 80), 'Overview', fill=TEXT, font=font(26))

# KPI cards
card_gap = 16
card_w = (content_right - content_x - 3 * card_gap) // 4
card_h = 120
card_y = 130
cards = [
    ('Active Users', '8,421', '▲ 6.2%', SUCCESS),
    ('MRR', '$48.3k', '▲ 3.1%', SUCCESS),
    ('Churn', '1.8%', '▼ 0.4%', DANGER),
    ('NPS', '62', '▲ 2', SUCCESS),
]
for i, (label, value, delta, delta_color) in enumerate(cards):
    x = content_x + i * (card_w + card_gap)
    d.rounded_rectangle([x, card_y, x + card_w, card_y + card_h], radius=10, fill=SURFACE, outline=BORDER, width=1)
    d.text((x + 18, card_y + 16), label, fill=MUTED, font=font(13))
    d.text((x + 18, card_y + 42), value, fill=TEXT, font=font(28))
    d.text((x + 18, card_y + 88), delta, fill=delta_color, font=font(13))

# Chart card
chart_y = card_y + card_h + 24
chart_h = 310
d.rounded_rectangle([content_x, chart_y, content_right, chart_y + chart_h], radius=10, fill=SURFACE, outline=BORDER, width=1)
d.text((content_x + 20, chart_y + 16), 'Weekly Trends', fill=TEXT, font=font(15))
# Legend
d.line([content_x + 150, chart_y + 22, content_x + 170, chart_y + 22], fill=PRIMARY, width=3)
d.text((content_x + 176, chart_y + 14), 'Sessions', fill=SUBTLE, font=font(12))
d.line([content_x + 250, chart_y + 22, content_x + 270, chart_y + 22], fill=SUCCESS, width=3)
d.text((content_x + 276, chart_y + 14), 'Signups', fill=SUBTLE, font=font(12))

# Plot area
plot_x1 = content_x + 40
plot_x2 = content_right - 20
plot_y1 = chart_y + 60
plot_y2 = chart_y + chart_h - 30
# Grid
for i in range(5):
    gy = plot_y1 + i * (plot_y2 - plot_y1) // 4
    d.line([plot_x1, gy, plot_x2, gy], fill='#1f2a3a', width=1)
# Horizontal category grid
sessions = [1200, 1340, 1280, 1520, 1610, 1490, 1700]
signups = [220, 260, 240, 300, 320, 290, 360]
min_sessions = 1100
max_sessions = 1800
min_signups = 150
max_signups = 400
def map_val(v, lo, hi, top, bottom):
    return top + (v - lo) / (hi - lo) * (bottom - top)

pts_sessions = [
    (plot_x1 + i * (plot_x2 - plot_x1) / (len(sessions) - 1), map_val(v, min_sessions, max_sessions, plot_y1, plot_y2))
    for i, v in enumerate(sessions)
]
pts_signups = [
    (plot_x1 + i * (plot_x2 - plot_x1) / (len(signups) - 1), map_val(v, min_signups, max_signups, plot_y1, plot_y2))
    for i, v in enumerate(signups)
]
d.line(pts_sessions, fill=PRIMARY, width=3, joint='curve')
d.line(pts_signups, fill=SUCCESS, width=3, joint='curve')
# Category labels
labels = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun']
for i, label in enumerate(labels):
    x = plot_x1 + i * (plot_x2 - plot_x1) / (len(labels) - 1)
    d.text((x - 10, plot_y2 + 8), label, fill=MUTED, font=font(11))

# Table card
table_y = chart_y + chart_h + 24
table_h = 230
d.rounded_rectangle([content_x, table_y, content_right, table_y + table_h], radius=10, fill=SURFACE, outline=BORDER, width=1)
d.text((content_x + 20, table_y + 14), 'Top Accounts', fill=TEXT, font=font(15))
headers = ['Account', 'Plan', 'MRR', 'Status']
rows = [
    ('Northwind Traders', 'Enterprise', '$4,200', ('active', SUCCESS, SUCCESS_SOFT)),
    ('Contoso Ltd', 'Growth', '$1,150', ('active', SUCCESS, SUCCESS_SOFT)),
    ('Fabrikam Inc', 'Growth', '$980', ('past due', DANGER, DANGER_SOFT)),
    ('Tailspin Toys', 'Starter', '$240', ('active', SUCCESS, SUCCESS_SOFT)),
]
header_y = table_y + 46
header_h = 34
col_widths = [380, 240, 180, 340]
col_x = [content_x + 20]
for w in col_widths[:-1]:
    col_x.append(col_x[-1] + w)
# Header background spans almost full width
d.rectangle([content_x + 15, header_y, content_right - 15, header_y + header_h], fill=SURFACE_MUTED)
d.line([content_x + 15, header_y + header_h, content_right - 15, header_y + header_h], fill=BORDER, width=1)
for i, header in enumerate(headers):
    d.text((col_x[i], header_y + 10), header.upper(), fill=MUTED, font=font(11))
row_y = header_y + header_h
badge_w = 74
for name, plan, mrr, (status, status_color, status_bg) in rows:
    d.text((col_x[0], row_y + 12), name, fill=TEXT, font=font(13))
    d.text((col_x[1], row_y + 12), plan, fill=SUBTLE, font=font(13))
    d.text((col_x[2], row_y + 12), mrr, fill=TEXT, font=font(13))
    d.rounded_rectangle([col_x[3], row_y + 6, col_x[3] + badge_w, row_y + 26], radius=8, fill=status_bg)
    d.text((col_x[3] + 14, row_y + 10), status, fill=status_color, font=font(11))
    d.line([content_x + 15, row_y + 34, content_right - 15, row_y + 34], fill=BORDER_SUBTLE, width=1)
    row_y += 34

img.save(OUT)
print('Saved fallback dark-mode preview to', OUT)
